arabic_blocks: [327] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال : أخبرنا مالك عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم عن أبيه عن عائشة زوج النبي ﷺ قالت خرجنا مع رسول الله ﷺ في بعض أسفاره حتى إذا كنا بالبيداء أو بذات الجيش انقطع عقد لي فأقام رسول الله ﷺ على التماسه وأقام الناس معه وليسوا على ماء فأتى الناس إلى أبي بكر الصديق فقالوا ألا ترى ما صنعت عائشة أقامت برسول الله ﷺ والناس وليسوا على ماء وليس معهم ماء فجاء أبو بكر ورسول الله ﷺ واضع رأسه على فخذي قد نام ، فقال حبست رسول الله ﷺ والناس وليسوا على ماء وليس معهم ماء فقالت عائشة فعاتبني أبو بكر ، وقال : ما شاء الله أن يقول وجعل يطعنني بيده في خاصرتي فلا يمنعني من التحرك إلا مكان رسول الله ﷺ على فخذي فقام رسول الله ﷺ حين أصبح على غير ماء فأنزل الله آية التيمم فتيمموا ، فقال أسيد بن الحضير ما هي بأول بركتكم يا آل أبي بكر قالت فبعثنا البعير الذي كنت عليه فأصبنا العقد تحته
english_blocks: ‘Abd Allah ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Malik informed us, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, who said:

We set out with the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, on one of his journeys. When we were at al-Bayda’ or Dhat al-Jaysh, a necklace of mine broke. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stayed to search for it, and the people stayed with him. They were not at a place with water. The people came to Abu Bakr al-Siddiq and said: “Do you not see what ‘A’ishah has done? She has kept the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and the people here, where there is no water, and they have no water with them.”

Abu Bakr came while the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was asleep with his head resting on my thigh. He said: “You have detained the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and the people, where there is no water, and they have no water with them.” ‘A’ishah said: Abu Bakr reproached me, saying what Allah willed him to say, and began poking me in my side with his hand. Nothing kept me from moving except the position of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, on my thigh.

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, rose when morning came, without water. Allah then revealed the verse of tayammum, and they performed tayammum. Usayd ibn al-Hudayr said: “This is not the first of your blessings, family of Abu Bakr.” She said: We made the camel on which I had been riding stand up and found the necklace beneath it.

notes: The selected chain has أخبرنا (informed us), agreeing with the modern print; the historical print has أخبرني (informed me). The selected wording remains unchanged. The two possible place names, repeated lack of water, full name Abu Bakr al-Siddiq, change to Aisha said and final camel/necklace sentence remain.

The selected and modern wording use Usayd ibn al-Hudayr; the historical print omits the article. The selected form remains. No cause of pain, material of the necklace or verse identification is added to the report.

The digital source presents the opening Quran quotation as its first chapter heading. Both printed witnesses put the quotation before an untitled first chapter. This batch retains the selected digital grouping and explains that difference; the quotation is not part of either numbered report.

arabic_blocks: [328] حدثنا محمد بن سنان قال : حدثنا هشيم ح قال وحدثني سعيد بن النضر قال : أخبرنا هشيم قال : أخبرنا سيار قال : حدثنا يزيد هو ابن صهيب الفقير قال : أخبرنا جابر بن عبد الله أن النبي ﷺ قال : أعطيت خمسا لم يعطهن أحد قبلي نصرت بالرعب مسيرة شهر وجعلت لي الأرض مسجدا وطهورا فأيما رجل من أمتي أدركته الصلاة فليصل وأحلت لي المغانم ولم تحل لأحد قبلي وأعطيت الشفاعة وكان النبي يبعث إلى قومه خاصة وبعثت إلى الناس عامة
english_blocks: Muhammad ibn Sinan related to us. He said: Hushaym related to us.

Another chain: He said: And Sa‘id ibn al-Nadr related to me. He said: Hushaym informed us. He said: Sayyar informed us. He said: Yazid—who is Ibn Suhayb, al-Faqir—related to us. He said: Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah informed us that the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said:

I have been given five things that no one before me was given. I have been aided by fear over a distance of a month’s journey. The earth has been made for me a place of prayer and a means of purification, so whichever man of my community is overtaken by the time of prayer, let him pray. The spoils have been made lawful for me, though they were not lawful for anyone before me. I have been given intercession. A prophet used to be sent to his own people specifically, while I have been sent to all people.
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: Both chains remain, with ح represented by Another chain. The selected distinctions between related to us, related to me and informed us are preserved. Fath al-Bari specifically discusses these reporting verbs. Yazid’s stated identification as Ibn Suhayb and his epithet al-Faqir remain; the epithet is not translated as poor, since the consulted commentary explains a different origin.

All five statements remain in source order. The rendering of طهورا as a means of purification follows the selected wording, compared English and consulted commentary. No rule about eligible ground, added timing condition, description of intercession or parenthetical enemies is imported into the narration. The historical print adds an honorific after the final occurrence of prophet; the selected and modern wording do not, so it is not inserted.

arabic_blocks: [329] حدثنا زكريا بن يحيى قال : حدثنا عبد الله بن نمير قال : حدثنا هشام بن عروة عن أبيه عن عائشة أنها استعارت من أسماء قلادة فهلكت فبعث رسول الله ﷺ رجلا فوجدها فأدركتهم الصلاة وليس معهم ماء فصلوا فشكوا ذلك إلى رسول الله ﷺ فأنزل الله آية التيمم ، فقال أسيد بن حضير لعائشة جزاك الله خيرا فوالله ما نزل بك أمر تكرهينه إلا جعل الله ذلك لك وللمسلمين فيه خيرا
english_blocks: Zakariyya ibn Yahya related to us. He said: ‘Abd Allah ibn Numayr related to us. He said: Hisham ibn ‘Urwah related to us, from his father, from ‘A’ishah:

That she borrowed a necklace from Asma’ and it was lost. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sent a man, who found it. The time of prayer came upon them, and they had no water with them, so they prayed. They complained of that to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and Allah revealed the verse of tayammum. Usayd ibn Hudayr said to ‘A’ishah: “May Allah reward you with good. By Allah, no matter that you dislike has befallen you without Allah making good in it for you and for the Muslims.”

arabic_blocks: [330] حدثنا يحيى بن بكير قال : حدثنا الليث عن جعفر بن ربيعة عن الأعرج قال : سمعت عميرا مولى ابن عباس قال أقبلت أنا وعبد الله بن يسار مولى ميمونة زوج النبي ﷺ حتى دخلنا على أبي جهيم بن الحارث بن الصمة الأنصارى ، فقال أبو الجهيم أقبل النبي ﷺ من نحو بئر جمل فلقيه رجل فسلم عليه فلم يرد عليه النبي ﷺ حتى أقبل على الجدار فمسح بوجهه ويديه ثم رد عليه السلام
english_blocks: Yahya ibn Bukayr related to us. He said: Al-Layth related to us, from Ja‘far ibn Rabi‘ah, from al-A‘raj, who said: I heard ‘Umayr, the mawla of Ibn ‘Abbas, say:
I came with ‘Abd Allah ibn Yasar, the mawla of Maymunah, the wife of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, until we entered upon Abu Juhaym ibn al-Harith ibn al-Simmah al-Ansari.

The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came from the direction of Bi’r Jamal. A man met him and greeted him. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, did not respond to him until he came to the wall and wiped his face and hands. Then he returned his greeting.

arabic_blocks: [331] حدثنا آدم قال : حدثنا شعبة حدثنا الحكم عن ذر عن سعيد بن عبد الرحمن بن أبزى عن أبيه قال جاء رجل إلى عمر بن الخطاب ، فقال إني أجنبت فلم أصب الماء ، فقال عمار بن ياسر لعمر بن الخطاب أما تذكر أنا كنا في سفر أنا وأنت فأما أنت فلم تصل وأما أنا فتمعكت فصليت فذكرت ذلك للنبي ﷺ ، فقال النبي ﷺ إنما كان يكفيك هكذا فضرب النبي ﷺ بكفيه الأرض ونفخ فيهما ثم مسح بهما وجهه وكفيه
english_blocks: Adam related to us. He said: Shu‘bah related to us; al-Hakam related to us, from Dharr, from Sa‘id ibn ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza, from his father, who said:

A man came to ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab and said: “I entered a state of janabah and could not find water.” ‘Ammar ibn Yasir said to ‘Umar ibn al-Khattab: “Do you not remember that we were on a journey, I and you? You did not pray, while I rolled about and prayed. I mentioned that to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘This alone would have been enough for you.’” The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, struck the earth with his hands and blew on them, then wiped his face and hands with them.

notes: The full chain has Said ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Abza, from his father. The checked Bewley opening instead names Abd al-Rahman and then his father. The selected chain, supported by both inspected Arabic prints, remains without importing that different attribution. The historical print has an additional said before al-Hakam related to us; the shorter selected and modern wording remain.

The selected wording includes إنما before كان يكفيك, as does the historical print. The modern print omits that particle. The restrictive wording remains in the working English. Blowing on the hands is explicit; blowing dust off is not added. The spoken recollection, the repeated names and the complete final demonstration remain.

The historical chapter heading explicitly mentions blowing after striking the ground. The selected and modern chapter heading asks whether the person performing tayammum blows on them. The selected shorter heading is retained; the chapter title is separate from the narration.
